name: [FREE UGC!] Max Mara Coats Adventure
desc:
Our journey in Max Mara Coats Adventure has come to an end. A huge thank you to everyone! 💛 Your energy made it unforgettable! Enjoy this last week and keep your curiosity alive! 👋🏻🧸

-------------------------
Join the Max Mara Sunset Walk, collect all the stitches, take a screenshot on the bench, and share your memory on social media with #MaxMaraSunsetWalk. Unlock your UGC in the daily Drop!

Jump on the Max Mara rollercoaster and immerse yourself in Max Mara Coats Adventure: a world full of style, creativity and endless fun! 💥
🧸🧸🧸

🎵 Follow the rhythm in TailorTrax: Sew stitches and play with friends! 🤝
 🧩 Solve puzzles in the Pattern Lab to create new clothing items! 👚
 👟 Run and jump in the Color Parkour to collect new colour palettes and customise your style! 🎨
 🔎 Explore the Wunderkammer to unlock your Daimon and get new power-ups! 🐲

🎉 Log in every day for special REWARDS!

Join the adventure, meet new friends and create together with them: no Robux required!
